recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, high-key composition featuring three stylized, faceless figures rendered in loose watercolor and ink. The figures are arranged in a central cluster against a stark white background, topped by two distinct layers of typography: a large, thin geometric sans-serif and a fluid, expressive cursive script.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between structured geometric type and fluid organic illustration
Vertical alignment of figures creating a central anchor
Muted, desaturated color palette against a dominant white field
Layering of script over the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure, slightly larger and facing forward, acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large geometric header, drop to the script, and then flow down through the watercolor figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounds the central elements, emphasizing the airy, light feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value (brightness) dominates the scene.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muted earth tones and pale blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric Sans Serif and Monoline Script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses ultra-thin strokes with wide circular proportions
Script text uses a rapid, continuous-line motion with varying pressure
Tight tracking on display text to create a horizontal bar effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and D are perfectly circular
Script 't' and 'f' have long, sweeping crossbars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid geometry and organic handwriting.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and thin stroke weight.
Captures the rapid, informal handwriting style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a watercolor illustration of three figures (two side profiles, one center facing) in a loose, impressionistic style. Use a palette of dusty rose, pale blue, and tan. Keep the background solid white. Use thin, sketchy ink lines to define edges without filling in facial details.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large uppercase header in a thin geometric sans-serif (pale blue) at the top. Layer a smaller, terracotta-colored cursive script directly underneath, allowing it to slightly overlap the bottom of the header letters.

verificationChecks: Are the figures faceless and impressionistic?
Is the display font ultra-thin and geometric?
Does the script look like natural handwriting?

adjustableVariables: Degree of overlap between text layers
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-key lighting and white space
Ensure typography is legible despite thin weights
Verify watercolor edges are soft and blended
Confirm the script color provides a warm accent
recipe.reuseFormula: Impressionistic watercolor figures + high-key white space + thin geometric header + overlapping organic script.
